lines.en: label dormwarsfive11:
{i}Roughly two hours later, inside of an unsuspecting and nondescript building full of nubile flesh.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约两小时之后，在一栋毫不起眼、却塞满了青春胴体的建筑里。{/i}

lines.en: scene stripswimwar1
Now that both dates have come to an end and I have kissed both competitors, I am finally ready to make a decision in regard to which one I would like to continue kissing.
lines.zh: 既然两场约会都已结束，而我也吻过了两位选手，我终于准备好做出决定了——到底想继续吻哪一个。

lines.en: Or just whoever had the better date, which I believe is the entire point of the competition, but I’ll choose however I want to choose because that is what it means to be free.
lines.zh: 或者只是谁的那场约会更棒，我相信那才是这场比赛的真正意义。不过我想怎么选就怎么选，因为那就是自由的含义。

lines.en: First, though, I must figure out why we are at a strip club.
lines.zh: 不过首先，我得弄清楚我们为什么会在一家脱衣舞俱乐部里。

lines.en: : I have a question.
lines.zh: : 我有个问题。

lines.en: : Is it about why we’re at a strip club?
lines.zh: : 是关于我们为什么在脱衣舞俱乐部里吗？

lines.en: : You know me so well, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你太了解我了，Ayane。

lines.en: : This is where we finished up the Dorm Wars last year. And we figured coming back here would be the safest way to keep Imani from finding out.
lines.zh: : 去年我们就是在这儿结束宿舍战争的。我们想，回到这儿是防止 Imani 发现的最安全方式。

lines.en: : Plus, the distinct lack of males in this city has all but run this business into the ground! They’ll take anything they can get at this point.
lines.zh: : 而且，这座城市里男性的极度匮乏，几乎已经把这行生意做垮了！到这个地步，她们什么都肯接。

lines.en: : Right. And the police tape?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那警戒线呢？

lines.en: : That was here when we showed up. It’s probably nothing. Just try and go under it if you can so we don’t disturb the crime scene.
lines.zh: : 我们来的时候它就在那儿了。大概没什么。尽量从下面钻过去，别破坏犯罪现场。

lines.en: : But wouldn’t crossing it and hanging out {i}inside{/i} of said crime scene-
lines.zh: : 可我们跨过去、还待在那个犯罪现场{i}里面{/i}——

lines.en: : Blah blah blah. That’s a problem for future 1-A. For now, we proceed!
lines.zh: :  废话废话废话。那是未来的 1-A 要操心的问题。现在，我们前进！

lines.en: : And we do so in highly controversial fashion as this is the most up-front we’ve ever been about our mutual interest in you! What could possibly go wrong?
lines.zh: : 而且是以极具争议的方式前进，因为这是我们第一次如此坦率地承认我们对你的共同兴趣！还能出什么岔子呢？

lines.en: : Everything. Which I am sure you are already aware of, so I guess we should just get the ball rolling then.
lines.zh: : 什么岔子都可能出。而我相信你已经意识到了，所以我想我们就开始吧。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar2
: Two girls — two dates! And for the first time in Dorm Wars history, we won’t ask for any details!
lines.zh: : 两个女孩——两场约会！而且这是宿舍战争史上第一次，我们不追问任何细节！

lines.en: : We’ll just silently wonder what happened until our friends cave and explain everything to us later on!
lines.zh: : 我们只会默默好奇发生了什么，直到我们的朋友扛不住、事后全招了！

lines.en: : Sensei and I found a portal to Hell.
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我发现了一扇通往地狱的门。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar3
: Damn. And I thought {i}I{/i} had a good time.
lines.zh: : 靠。{i}我{/i}还以为我玩得挺开心的。

lines.en: : I am no longer silently wondering. I am wondering out loud.
lines.zh: : 我不再默默好奇了。我现在要大声好奇。

lines.en: : {size=-1}Well, wonder later. Because, from what I understand, everything that is about to happen inside of this room revolves around me and I am too much of a narcissist to wait any longer.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}那好奇晚点再说。因为据我所知，这个房间里即将发生的一切都围绕着我，而我又是个自恋狂，一刻都等不了了。{/size}

lines.en: scene stripswimwar4
: The winner of this year’s date war...
lines.zh: : 今年约会战争的胜者是……

lines.en: menu:
Rin
lines.zh: Rin

lines.en: : ...is Rin Rokuhara.
lines.zh: : ……是 Rin Rokuhara。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar5
: Really? Even though all we did was sit in my room? Was Hell really that terrifying?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可我们只是坐在我房间里而已啊？地狱真的有那么可怕吗？

lines.en: : I had a great time with both of you. And yes, Io’s date was far more exciting. But it was more...exploration than an actual “date” to me I guess.
lines.zh: : 我和你们俩都玩得很开心。是的，Io 的那场约会更刺激。但对我来说，它更像是……探索，而不是一场真正的「约会」，我想。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar6
: It’s okay, Io...there will be more. Like, maybe you can show me what you guys found next-
lines.zh: : 没事的，Io……以后还会有的。比如，也许下次你可以带我去看你们找到的——

lines.en: : You don’t need to cheer me up, Uta. I already knew I was going to lose.
lines.zh: : 你不用安慰我，Uta。我早就知道自己会输。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar7
: The contest portion doesn’t really matter, though. I’m just glad there was finally a part of this event that I didn’t inherently despise. Thanks for that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过比赛那部分其实无所谓。我只是很高兴，这个活动里终于有了一个我天生不讨厌的环节。谢谢你，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thank {i}you.{/i} Both of you, actually. I had a lot of fun this year.
lines.zh: : 谢谢{i}你{/i}。其实是谢谢你们两位。今年我玩得很开心。

lines.en: : This wasn’t an easy choice.
lines.zh: : 这不是个容易的选择。

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ rindatewin = True
Io
lines.zh: Io

lines.en: : ...is Io Ichimonji.
lines.zh: : ……是 Io Ichimonji。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar8
: But...{i}I’m{/i} Io Ichimonji.
lines.zh: : 可……{i}我{/i}就是 Io Ichimonji 啊。

lines.en: : You’re Io Ichimonji the {i}winner{/i} now! I told you you had a shot! See?!
lines.zh: : 你现在是{i}赢家{/i} Io Ichimonji 了！我说过你还有机会的！看到了吧？！

lines.en: : No, I think Sensei just forgot my name. Or he remembered my name and said the wrong one on accident.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得 Sensei 只是忘了我的名字。或者他记得我的名字，只是不小心说错了另一个。

lines.en: : I didn’t say anything on accident. It’s just hard to lose when you make a discovery like we did. And it was a very {i}Io{/i} date, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 我没有不小心说错任何话。只是当你们有了我们那种发现时，真的很难输。而且总的来说，那是一场非常{i}「Io」{/i}的约会。

lines.en: : That just makes it sound even worse.
lines.zh: : 那听起来更糟了。

lines.en: : Welp...it...is what it is, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我想……就是这样了。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar9
: Can’t really compete with a...portal to Hell.
lines.zh: : 毕竟没法跟一扇……通往地狱的门比。

lines.en: : I obviously had a great time with you too, Rin. I’ll remember {i}both{/i} of these dates for a long time.
lines.zh: : 我显然和你也玩得很开心，Rin。这两场约会我{i}都{/i}会记很久。

lines.en: : I’m just reluctant to say “forever” because forever is constantly expanding and the likelihood of me remembering anything at all gets slimmer every single day.
lines.zh: : 只是我不太愿意说「永远」，因为永远在不断膨胀，而我还能记住任何事的可能性每一天都在变小。

lines.en: : Either way, it wasn’t an easy choice.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，这都不是个容易的选择。

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ iodatewin = True
Ayane
lines.zh: Ayane

lines.en: : ...is Ayane Amamiya.
lines.zh: : ……是 Ayane Amamiya。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar10
: Again?! But I wasn’t even there this time!
lines.zh: : 又来？！可这次我根本没参赛啊！

lines.en: : Which makes it all the more impressive that you managed to win.
lines.zh: : 而这恰恰让你赢了这件事更加了不起。

lines.en: : I feel like there has to be some kinda rule against this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这肯定有哪条规则不准这么干。

lines.en: : We can’t let you {i}always{/i} just pick whoever you want even if they’re not an option, Sensei. If we do that, your secret OG love squad thingy will just always win.
lines.zh: : 我们不能让你{i}永远{/i}想选谁就选谁，哪怕她们根本不在选项里，Sensei。要是那样，你那个秘密的元老后宫团就永远赢了。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar11
: How do you even know about the love squad? I thought that’s just what they called each other.
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道后宫团的事？我以为那只是她们互相之间的称呼。

lines.en: : I’m the new gossip queen now that Chika is broken. I know everything.
lines.zh: : Chika 废了之后，我现在是新任八卦女王。我什么都知道。

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m really happy that you keep choosing me for stuff, but-
lines.zh: : Sensei……你一直选我，我真的很开心，不过——

lines.en: : If Ayane doesn’t win, nobody wins. Both Io and Rin’s dates were too close to choose from, so I need to go with Ayane. Or Uta if Ayane won’t accept the win.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ayane 不赢，那就谁都别赢。Io 和 Rin 的约会太接近了，无从选择，所以我得选 Ayane。或者如果 Ayane 不接受这个胜利，就选 Uta。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar12
: You know, maybe it’s okay to let people who aren’t in the running be chosen sometimes. I will gladly accept this victory since Ayane won’t-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有时候让不在候选名单里的人被选中也没什么不好。既然 Ayane 不接受，我很乐意笑纳这个胜利——

lines.en: : I accept. And I will...absolutely repay you for this soon. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我接受。而且我一定会……尽快报答你的。我保证。

lines.en: : There’s no need to “repay” me for anything when {i}I’m{/i} the one repaying you right now.
lines.zh: : 现在是我正在报答你，所以没什么需要「报答」{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : Either way, it wasn’t an easy choice.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，这都不是个容易的选择。

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ ayanedatewin = True
: But it’s the choice I made and I’m going to stick by it.
lines.zh: : 但这是我做出的选择，而我会坚持到底。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar13
: Now — bring on all of the attention. Just not if it’s going to devolve into a massive fight between all of you. Which it may.
lines.zh: : 那么——把所有的关注都砸过来吧。只要别演变成你们之间的一场大混战。虽然很可能会。

lines.en: : We’ll get started with the model marathon in a sec. I’ll tell Tsuneyo and Sana to go get dressed.
lines.zh: : 我们马上开始模特马拉松。我会去叫 Tsuneyo 和 Sana 去换衣服。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar14
: Io — you wanted to leave though, right?
lines.zh: : Io——不过你想走了，对吧？

lines.en: : When the alternative is to hang out in a strip club and watch people I don’t like strip? Yes. I am going to leave.
lines.zh: : 当另一个选择是待在脱衣舞俱乐部里看我不喜欢的人脱衣服？是的。我要走了。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar15
: Thanks for including me this time, though. I hereby agree to participate in all contests where I get to associate only with Sensei. Or Uta.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你们这次带上我。在此我同意参加所有只需要和 Sensei 打交道的活动。或者 Uta。

lines.en: : Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar16
: Uhh...forgive her. Io’s not really built for this kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃……原谅她吧。Io 真的不是为这种事而生的。

lines.en: : I don’t think any of us really expected her to stick around anyway. Especially not after last year.
lines.zh: : 我想我们本来也没指望她会留下来。尤其是去年那件事之后。

lines.en: : I’m just confused. I didn’t think straight girls were allowed to wear denim jackets.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点困惑。我不知道直女也能穿牛仔外套。

lines.en: scene black
After taking a moment to tally up the scores and update the apparent Dorm Wars app (which is also a thing now), the girls lead me inside the main room.
lines.zh: 花了一点时间统计分数、更新那个显然存在的宿舍战争 App（现在连那个都有了）之后，女孩们把我领进了主厅。

lines.en: It seems like most of the class has shown up, but there are several notable exceptions.
lines.zh: 看起来班上大部分人都到了，但也有几个值得注意的缺席者。

lines.en: Probably those who were {i}rightfully{/i} uncomfortable about the idea of openly competing for my love and affection when it’s been mostly a secretive thing so far.
lines.zh: 大概就是那些对公开争夺我的爱与感情这件事{i}理所当然{/i}感到不适的人，毕竟到目前为止它一直是个秘密。

lines.en: Of course a secret like this would never last forever, though. And of course it was always going to lead to something like this.
lines.zh: 当然，这样的秘密永远不可能永远守住。也当然，它终究会导向今天这种局面。

lines.en: I just figured there’d be more bloodshed and less...friendly competition.
lines.zh: 我只是以为会流更多的血，少一点……友好的竞争。

lines.en: I guess there’s still time for the former, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想前者还有时间发生。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar17
Especially if people like Nodoka, who are well-versed in the act of starting problems, are here.
lines.zh: 尤其是如果像 Nodoka 这种深谙如何挑起事端的人在场的话。

lines.en: : Well, if it isn’t the man of the hour.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这不是今天的男主角吗。

lines.en: : Hey. You feeling any better today?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今天感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: : Are you implying that I was unwell yesterday?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示我昨天不舒服吗？

lines.en: : By your standards, yeah. Because you not only fell asleep on my shoulder, but looked very cute while doing so. You’re not supposed to be cute. You’re supposed to be Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 按你的标准，是的。因为你不仅枕着我肩膀睡着了，而且睡着的样子还非常可爱。你不该是可爱的。你该是 Nodoka 才对。

lines.en: : And Nodoka isn’t cute?
lines.zh: : 而 Nodoka 不可爱吗？

lines.en: : No. Just creepily seductive and situationally hot.
lines.zh: : 不可爱。只是诡异地充满诱惑，以及在某些情境下很辣。

lines.en: : Hm.
scene stripswimwar18
: I suppose I {i}am{/i} feeling “better” then. Though, I’m not quite sure that’s how I’d describe it myself.
lines.zh: : 那么我想我{i}确实{/i}感觉「好些」了。不过，我不太确定自己会不会用这个词来形容。

lines.en: : Well...how would you, then?
lines.zh: : 那……你会怎么形容？

lines.en: : Akira — have you ever touched the bottom of a swimming pool?
lines.zh: : Akira——你摸过游泳池的池底吗？

lines.en: : All the time. Huge hobby of mine.
lines.zh: : 经常摸。我的一大爱好。

lines.en: : Then, as someone with far more {i}experience{/i} than me, surely I don’t need to inform you of the high that accompanies such a simple feat.
lines.zh: : 那么，作为一个{i}经验{/i}远比我丰富的人，想必不需要我来告诉你，完成这样一个简单壮举所带来的快感。

lines.en: : There’s this moment, you see — where you feel nothing at all. And you’re drifting from the top to the bottom, suspended in a position of wet uncertainty.
lines.zh: : 你知道，有那么一个瞬间——你什么都感觉不到。你从水面漂向池底，悬在一个潮湿的不确定之中。

lines.en: : Wet uncertainty. Couldn’t have said it better myself.
lines.zh: : 潮湿的不确定。我自己都说不出更贴切的词。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar19
: That transitory state of being, sandwiched between a beginning and an end, is one I’ve grown comfortable in. But there has always been this...desire.
lines.zh: : 那种夹在开始与结束之间的过渡状态，是我已经习惯待的地方。但一直有这个……渴望。

lines.en: : To empty my lungs of air. To touch the bottom of the pool — just to see how it feels. Just to know that I {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 把肺里的空气排空。去触摸池底——只为看看那是什么感觉。只为知道我{i}能{/i}做到。

lines.en: : I believe I did that yesterday. And I believe that means I can now float {i}safely{/i} back to the surface and feel the sun on my skin once more.
lines.zh: : 我想，我昨天做到了。而我想那意味着我现在可以{i}安全地{/i}浮回水面，重新感受阳光照在皮肤上。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar20
: Can you open your eyes underwater, Akira? Because I can. And I barely notice a difference at all.
lines.zh: : 你能在水下睁开眼睛吗，Akira？因为我可以。而我几乎感觉不出有什么区别。

lines.en: : Surely you’ve seen the light penetrate the water, yes? Like the untouched flesh of a young girl’s pussy as it’s claimed by her older brother in the dead of the night?
lines.zh: : 你肯定见过光穿透水面吧？就像深夜里，一个年轻女孩未被触碰的私处被她哥哥占有时的模样？

lines.en: : None of it’s consensual, Akira. The water wants to hide behind itself — just as that girl did beneath her covers.
lines.zh: : 那一切都不是出于自愿的，Akira。水想躲在它自己身后——就像那个女孩躲在被单底下一样。

lines.en: : But the fact that it happens against one’s will doesn’t change the fact that it still feels {i}good.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可它违背人的意愿发生，并不改变它仍旧让人感觉{i}很好{/i}这个事实。

lines.en: : I believe I may have been sodomized yesterday. By the world itself.
lines.zh: : 我想，我昨天可能被鸡奸了。是被这个世界本身。

lines.en: : {size=-2}And all the while, everyone got to look on and watch. Calling me “odd” or “unusual” due to the lack of verbal venom and the somewhat seductive soothsaying that combined into a tangible entity who didn’t show up for work.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}而与此同时，所有人都在一旁看着。因为我少了言语上的毒液、又多了几分诱惑性的预言，两者结合成了一个没有来上班的、有形的实体，于是他们叫我「古怪」或者「异常」。{/size}

lines.en: : I am so lost right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在完全听不懂。

lines.en: : Yes...aren’t we all?
lines.zh: : 是啊……我们不都是吗？

lines.en: scene stripswimwar21
: For we, too, are transitory. We know where we’re from...we know where we’ll end up. And we also know when we’re in motion.
lines.zh: : 因为我们同样也是过渡性的。我们知道自己来自哪里……我们知道自己将归于何处。我们也知道自己在运动之中。

lines.en: : Yet, if you remove just {i}one{/i} of those three prongs, what you get is something that seems more fiction than fact. Do you understand what I’m alluding to, Akira?
lines.zh: : 然而，只要抽掉这三根叉子中的{i}一{/i}根，你得到的就是某种看似虚构多于事实的东西。你明白我在暗指什么吗，Akira？

lines.en: : No. Please explain it in terms that even a pathetic layman like me can grasp.
lines.zh: : 不明白。请用连我这种可悲的门外汉都能懂的方式解释一下。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar22
: Akira — I believe that infinity itself may wear thigh-highs.
lines.zh: : Akira——我相信，无限本身也许穿着过膝袜。

lines.en: : And I believe you can fuck it if the right wish is made at the right time.
lines.zh: : 而我相信，如果在对的时间许下对的愿望，你就能操到它。

lines.en: : Ask me how.
lines.zh: : 问我怎么做。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar23
: Maybe later. I think some girls are about to take their clothes off for me.
lines.zh: : 也许晚点吧。我觉得有些女生要开始为我脱衣服了。

lines.en: : Yes...what a shame it would be to miss {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是的……错过了{i}那场面{/i}可就太可惜了。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar24
: Welcome one, welcome all — to the single greatest finale to {i}ever{/i} grace the Dorm Wars! And the most {i}unsafe{/i} safe space to ever be...safe in!
lines.zh: : 欢迎各位，欢迎所有人——来到{i}有史以来{/i}最伟大的宿舍战争终章！以及史上最{i}不安全{/i}的「安全空间」！

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is the den of debauchery! It’s the room the final boss is found in! But who {i}is{/i} that final boss, you ask?!
lines.zh: : {i}这里{/i}是堕落之巢！是最终 Boss 所在的房间！但要问那个最终 Boss {i}是{/i}谁？！

lines.en: scene stripswimwar25
: It’s {i}that{/i} guy all the way over there! The one...the only...Sensei! Also known as Akira Arakawa or, if your name is Ami, Dad! Or maybe “Sir” if your name is Molly!

lines.en: : Fact is — he has many names! And many qualities that each and every one of us have grown to either love or hate!
lines.zh: : 事实上——他有很多名字！也有很多特质，我们每个人都渐渐爱上了或者恨上了其中某一些！

lines.en: : Which is why {i}today,{/i} the gloves come off! And we acknowledge once and for all that {b}THIS IS WAR!{/b} That we all want {i}him{/i} as the prize!
lines.zh: : 正因如此，{i}今天{/i}， 手套摘下来了！我们要一次性地、彻底地承认——{b}这就是战争{/b}！我们都想要{i}他{/i}当奖品！

lines.en: : Is that term just a thing now? Is this what the young people are saying?

lines.en: : We have reached a {i}new{/i} era! One of unity! One of family! But most importantly — one where we are {i}free{/i} to make bad decisions!

lines.en: : For everyone in this room, including me, acknowledges here and now that we want a piece of that teacher and we don’t care who knows it!

lines.en: : I have no interest in taking off all of my clothes. I am too busy feeling like a giant beside the two of you miniature humans.
lines.zh: : 我没兴趣把衣服全脱了。我正忙着在你们两个迷你人类身边觉得自己像个巨人。

lines.en: : The time has come, Sensei! {i}Is{/i} flat really justice?! Or will the buxom beauty of this bronze-skinned babe prevail in the name of breasthood?! {i}You{/i} decide!
lines.zh: : 时候到了，Sensei！贫乳真的就{i}是{/i}正义吗？！还是说，这位古铜色美女的丰腴之美，将以胸部之名获胜？！由{i}你{/i}决定！

lines.en: : Who takes the crown in our first of two modeling competitions?!
lines.zh: : 谁将加冕我们两场模特比赛中的第一场？！

lines.en: : You know, I’m still not really comfortable with the...openness on display tonight.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我对今晚这种……开放程度还是不太适应。

lines.en: : But I am here to do a job and I feel that job would not be complete if I did not choose-
lines.zh: : 但我是来完成一项工作的，而我觉得如果不选——那项工作就不算完成。

lines.en: menu:
Sana
lines.zh: Sana

lines.en: : ...Sana as the winner.
lines.zh: : ……选 Sana 为胜者。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar43
: {i}Really?...{/i}I could have sworn you’d choose Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : {i}真的吗？{/i}……我还以为你会选 Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : This is blasphemous. I have been robbed. What is the point of being born perfect if I can not use it to my advantage in fashion contests?
lines.zh: : 这是亵渎。我被抢劫了。如果我生来完美，却不能在时尚比赛里以此占优，那完美还有什么意义？

lines.en: : Well, Sana — you did it. And all you had to do was wear essentially nothing on stage.
lines.zh: : 那么，Sana——你做到了。而你所做的，不过是穿着基本等于无的衣服上台。

lines.en: : Is there anything you’d like to say to the fans back home before we wrap this baby up and move onto the finale?
lines.zh: : 在我们收尾、进入决赛之前，你有什么想对家里的粉丝说的吗？

lines.en: : Just that...I’m happy it was me...
lines.zh: : 只想说……我很高兴是我……

lines.en: : And that I’ve maybe been...a little too...dismissive about...certain things a...certain person has said to me...
lines.zh: : 还有，我也许……一直有点……太……不把……某个人对我说的某些话当回事……

lines.en: : I’d like to know more...
lines.zh: : 我想知道更多……

lines.en: : I’ve always loved...learning things from...my favorite teacher...
lines.zh: : 我一直都喜欢……从……我最喜欢的老师那里……学东西……

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ sanaswimsuitwin = True
Tsuneyo
lines.zh: Tsuneyo

lines.en: : ...Tsuneyo as the winner.
lines.zh: : ……选 Tsuneyo 为胜者。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar44
: Naturally.
lines.zh: : 理所当然。

lines.en: : {i}Seriously?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}认真的吗？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s a swimsuit contest and hers is just the nicer swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 这是泳装比赛，而她的泳装就是更好看。

lines.en: : Plus, it’s hard to deny the allure of her body. Which isn’t to say that there’s no allure to {i}yours.{/i} It’s just-
lines.zh: : 再说，很难否认她身体的魅力。当然不是说{i}你的{/i}没有魅力。只是——

lines.en: : Small and pathetic when compared to that of a real woman.
lines.zh: : 和真正的女人比起来，又小又可怜。

lines.en: : Now, let’s not get ahead of ourselves. There’s plenty to love about lolis! It just seems like today is not their day.
lines.zh: : 好了，别太早下结论。萝莉有很多值得爱的地方！只是今天似乎不是她们的日子。

lines.en: : So, Tsunecchi! I ask you this — is there anything you’d like to say to the fans back home before we wrap this baby up and move onto the finale?
lines.zh: : 那么，Tsunecchi！我问你——在我们收尾、进入决赛之前，你有什么想对家里的粉丝说的吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Not...Not even a {i}little{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 一……{i}一点{/i}点都没有？

lines.en: : Fine. I will provide one small comment for the tabloid. And it is that I have accepted I will one day bed this man.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我就给小报提供一条简短的评论。那就是——我已经接受，我总有一天会与此人共枕。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar45
: And I imagine it will ruin other women for him for the rest of his life. The end.
lines.zh: : 而我想，那会让他余生里对其他女人都索然无味。完毕。

lines.en: : I...I don’t think we can put that...on the app...but, uhh...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得我们不能把那句……放到 App 上……不过，呃……

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ tsuneyoswimsuitwin = True
Ayane
lines.zh: Ayane

lines.en: : ...Ayane as the winner.
lines.zh: : ……选 Ayane 为胜者。

lines.en: scene stripswimwar46
: Sensei! Stop! You’re really starting to embarrass me!
lines.zh: : Sensei！停下！你真的开始让我难堪了！

lines.en: : Wow. You’re, uhh...{i}really{/i} into Ayane today, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你，呃……今天{i}真的{/i}很迷 Ayane 啊？

lines.en: : It is my personal mission to ensure that everyone looks back on this installment of the Dorm Wars as the one where Ayane won everything.
lines.zh: : 我的个人使命，就是确保每个人回望这一届宿舍战争时，都记得它是 Ayane 赢下一切的一届。

lines.en: : She’s worn a swimsuit before. It counts.
lines.zh: : 她以前穿过泳装。算数。

lines.en: : No it doesn’t! Choose Sana or Tsuneyo! Preferably Tsuneyo so you don’t encourage Sana to keep wearing things like this!
lines.zh: : 不算！选 Sana 或者 Tsuneyo！最好是 Tsuneyo，这样你就不会鼓励 Sana 继续穿这种东西了！

lines.en: : Fine.
: Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢！

lines.en: : I choose Ayane again.
lines.zh: : 我再选一次 Ayane。

lines.en: : AAAAAAAH!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！！！

lines.en: : I mean, like...it’d be rude if I got mad about this, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说，比如……如果我为此生气就太失礼了，不过……

lines.en: : An interesting and unexpected choice. Albeit the wrong one as I am the clear winner.
lines.zh: : 一个有趣而出人意料的选择。虽然是个错误的选择，因为明显的胜者是我。

lines.en: : Regardless, I support your decision and concede.
lines.zh: : 无论如何，我支持你的决定，并认输。

lines.en: : I guess...Ayane wins {i}again{/i} then!
lines.zh: : 我想……那 Ayane {i}又{/i}赢了！

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ ayaneswimsuitwin = True
scene black
: Anyway! That’s it for the swimsuit contest!
lines.zh: : 总之！泳装比赛到此结束！

lines.en: : We’ll take a brief intermission before moving onto the next one!
lines.zh: : 在进入下一项之前，我们稍微休息一下！

lines.en: : Sit tight, girls! Or...keep standing! We’ve got a whole night of fun left ahead of us!
lines.zh: : 坐着别动，姑娘们！或者……继续站着！我们今晚还有一整夜的乐趣在前头！
